items.title: Questioning whether perceived progress actually yields positive outcomes
items.quote: Progress - it's something for which many of us look in our daily lives, both professional and personal. Don't know who created this video, but I have to say I love it, and it resonates well with a quotation from Arthur Dent in the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy... I've gone off the idea of progress, it's over-rated! Progress for the sake of «good» is what we all seek, but as these photos depict very nicely - is that what we actually get? You decide. #progress
